Author bio: Together with the AI community, we are pushing the boundaries of what’s possible through open science to create a more connected world.
Text: Introducing Muse Code (beta), a terminal coding agent built for long-horizon software engineering, powered by our new Muse Spark 1.2 model.

Muse Code plans, implements, and validates complex, multi-file changes across large repositories with persistent sub-agents that solve difficult problems faster, more accurately, and with less intervention.
